relations.support_notes: Colophon, fol. 10b1: ‘dul ba ma lus pa'i snying po bsdu te bstan pa phrag dog med cing blo dang ldan pa rnams dga’ bas rgyas par byed pa’i rin po che’i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i gtan | shag kya’i dge' slong brtson 'grus ‘bar gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o ||

comments: Maybe identical with the "'dul ba'i spyi don" listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig along with a "'dul Tik." See [5RXEUKD9]: 536, No. 11708: bya 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus 'bar gyi 'dul Tik dang 'dul ba'i spyi don.
